C1 pipeline diagnostic: locate the large cost first
Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · M5 Ultra · 3 fresh servers · 8 warm + 8 diagnostic requests per mode
The repeated current-root call totals 18.5 ms across 4,072 steps: 0.022% of local service time.
Intervals overlap; compiled calls are nested. Successor submission can include backend pacing / waiting, not only GPU work.
One process per mode, fixed order; observer differences are descriptive. No new numerical qualification or Pareto point.
